sections.heading: What is trending: “virus”
paragraphs: “virus” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for IT (snapshot taken 2026-08-07T18:01:44+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Corriere della Sera, Il Sole 24 ORE, RaiNews. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Gli scienziati hanno usato l'intelligenza artificiale per creare virus che non esistono in natura per la prima volta” — Corriere della Sera
“L'intelligenza artificiale al servizio della lotta contro i batteri” — RaiNews
“Ora l’intelligenza artificiale può creare virus, è allarme rischi” — Il Sole 24 ORE

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 7 Aug 2026 10:40:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-07T18:01:44+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-07T18:02:44+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
